label: DRC v. Rwanda ICJ case status
delta: Aug 6, 2026: DRC memorial due Oct 4, 2027; Rwanda counter-memorial due Dec 4, 2028
deltaNote: ICJ set the merits-phase timetable Aug 6, 2026; oral hearings would begin in early 2029 with judgment roughly six months later if the schedule holds — a multi-year process despite the June admissibility ruling.

label: Washington Accords status
delta: Next JSCM monitoring session set for Sept 16-17, 2026 in Geneva, ahead of an October trilateral planning conference
deltaNote: DRC and M23 agreed a sequenced roadmap after Aug 17-21 Geneva talks; the first EJVM+ verification mission then deployed to Minembwe on Aug 24, but DRC accused M23 of killing 300+ people in June-July and M23 accused government forces of an artillery attack near Minembwe, signalling the mechanism has yet to reduce mutual distrust. At an Aug 12-13 Joint Security Coordination Mechanism (JSCM) session at the US Mission in Geneva, DRC and Rwanda agreed to advance two initiatives to strengthen on-the-ground monitoring and verification, and DRC presented its FDLR disarmament, demobilization and reintegration (DDR) plan; the next JSCM meeting is scheduled for Sept 16-17, 2026 in Geneva, feeding into an October trilateral planning conference meant to produce a revised Operations Order. FDLR disarmament remains the unresolved core DRC-Rwanda obligation.

label: Doha comprehensive peace deal target
contestNote: An Aug 22, 2026 roadmap set sequenced negotiation steps, but M23 has made no firm disarmament commitments and fighting widened across Fizi, Minembwe, Kalehe, Masisi and Walungu even as the roadmap was signed

label: Ebola (Bundibugyo virus) outbreak deaths
contestNote: Congolese health experts say the true toll may be several times higher than confirmed figures, since the outbreak — declared May 15, 2026 in Ituri — spread undetected for weeks beforehand.
delta: 7,200 confirmed cases as of the Sept 13, 2026 ECDC update (data through Sept 12)
deltaNote: Deaths passed the 3,000 mark for the first time on Sept 2 (3,007 deaths/6,186 cases); by the Sept 13 ECDC report (data through Sept 12) the toll had risen to 3,475 deaths among 7,200 confirmed cases across 62 of 167 health zones in 7 provinces — a gain of 126 deaths over three days — for a case fatality rate of roughly 48.3%, with 923 patients hospitalized in isolation and 88% of identified contacts under follow-up. The outbreak reached a new displacement site on Sept 13, with 3 confirmed cases among 70,000+ residents of the Savo Plain IDP site in Djugu, Ituri. Now DRC's largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak on record, surpassing the 2018-2020 outbreak's 3,317 cases, and the second-largest globally.
